list.definition:
SELECT asset
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE market IN ($market)
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY asset
ORDER BY count(DISTINCT rpt_dt) DESC, max(exchange_fee + registration_fee) FILTER (WHERE NOT day_trade) DESC, asset

panels.title: Contracts
panels.description: Number of selected contracts with fee lines in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT asset) AS contracts
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Fee lines (latest publication)
panels.description: Fee lines (modes, trade types and strategy legs) of the selected contracts in the latest report in range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT count(*) AS fee_lines
FROM d
WHERE rpt_dt = (SELECT max(rpt_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: Average change in range
panels.description: Mean change of the selected contracts' total unit cost from the first to the last publication in range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    market,
    asset,
    arg_max(exchange_fee + registration_fee, valid_from)::DOUBLE
      / nullif(arg_min(exchange_fee + registration_fee, valid_from)::DOUBLE, 0) - 1 AS change
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade = $mode
    AND trade_type = '0'
    AND coalesce(strategy_leg, '0') = '0'
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT avg(change) AS avg_change
FROM r

panels.title: Latest validity period
panels.description: Application window of the latest report in range for the selected contracts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(valid_from), '%Y-%m-%d') || ' → ' || strftime(max(valid_to), '%Y-%m-%d') AS validity
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Total unit cost per contract
panels.description: Exchange plus registration fee per contract (BRL) for the base fee line of each selected contract, by validity month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  asset || CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT market) OVER () > 1 THEN ' (mkt ' || market || ')' ELSE '' END AS contract,
  (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade = $mode
  AND trade_type = '0'
  AND coalesce(strategy_leg, '0') = '0'
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, contract

panels.title: Change since start of range
panels.description: Total unit cost relative to each contract's first publication in the range, to compare contracts on one scale.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT
    valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
    asset || CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT market) OVER () > 1 THEN ' (mkt ' || market || ')' ELSE '' END AS contract,
    (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade = $mode
    AND trade_type = '0'
    AND coalesce(strategy_leg, '0') = '0'
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT time, contract, total_fee / nullif(first_value(total_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY contract ORDER BY time), 0) - 1 AS change
FROM m
ORDER BY time, contract

panels.title: Monthly change
panels.description: Total unit cost vs the previous monthly publication, per selected contract.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT
    valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
    asset || CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT market) OVER () > 1 THEN ' (mkt ' || market || ')' ELSE '' END AS contract,
    (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade = $mode
    AND trade_type = '0'
    AND coalesce(strategy_leg, '0') = '0'
    AND valid_from::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 45 DAY
    AND valid_from::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
changes AS (
  SELECT time, contract, total_fee / nullif(lag(total_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY contract ORDER BY time), 0) - 1 AS change
  FROM m
)
SELECT time, contract, change
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, contract

panels.title: Exchange fee per contract
panels.description: Exchange fee component per contract (BRL) for each selected contract.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  asset || CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT market) OVER () > 1 THEN ' (mkt ' || market || ')' ELSE '' END AS contract,
  exchange_fee::DOUBLE AS exchange_fee
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade = $mode
  AND trade_type = '0'
  AND coalesce(strategy_leg, '0') = '0'
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, contract

panels.title: Registration fee per contract
panels.description: Registration fee component per contract (BRL) for each selected contract.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  asset || CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT market) OVER () > 1 THEN ' (mkt ' || market || ')' ELSE '' END AS contract,
  registration_fee::DOUBLE AS registration_fee
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade = $mode
  AND trade_type = '0'
  AND coalesce(strategy_leg, '0') = '0'
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Day-trade cost as % of regular
panels.description: Day-trade total unit cost over the regular one per selected contract; ignores the trade mode filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT
    valid_from,
    market,
    asset,
    sum(exchange_fee + registration_fee) FILTER (WHERE day_trade) AS day_trade_fee,
    sum(exchange_fee + registration_fee) FILTER (WHERE NOT day_trade) AS regular_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND trade_type = '0'
    AND coalesce(strategy_leg, '0') = '0'
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT
  valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  asset || CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT market) OVER () > 1 THEN ' (mkt ' || market || ')' ELSE '' END AS contract,
  (day_trade_fee / nullif(regular_fee, 0))::DOUBLE AS day_trade_ratio
FROM m
ORDER BY time, contract

panels.title: Basket cost (one contract each), stacked by contract
panels.description: Total unit cost of trading one contract of each selected contract, stacked so the top edge is the basket total.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  asset || CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT market) OVER () > 1 THEN ' (mkt ' || market || ')' ELSE '' END AS contract,
  (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade = $mode
  AND trade_type = '0'
  AND coalesce(strategy_leg, '0') = '0'
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, contract

panels.title: Basket cost by component
panels.description: Exchange and registration fees summed over the selected contracts, stacked so the top edge is the basket total.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  sum(exchange_fee)::DOUBLE AS "Exchange fee",
  sum(registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS "Registration fee"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND day_trade = $mode
  AND trade_type = '0'
  AND coalesce(strategy_leg, '0') = '0'
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Contracts listed per market
panels.description: Number of contracts with published unit costs per selected market, stacked; ignores the contract filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  CASE market WHEN '1' THEN 'Spot' WHEN '2' THEN 'Futures' WHEN '3' THEN 'Options on spot' WHEN '4' THEN 'Options on futures' ELSE market END AS market,
  count(DISTINCT asset) AS contracts
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE market IN ($market)
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, market

panels.title: Selected contracts (latest publication in range)
panels.description: Regular and day-trade unit costs, rollover cost and change vs the previous publication for every fee line of the selected contracts.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    exchange_fee + registration_fee AS total_fee,
    lag(exchange_fee + registration_fee) OVER (
      PARTITION BY market, asset, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg
      ORDER BY valid_from
    ) AS prev_total_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
    AND valid_from::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
l AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM d
  WHERE rpt_dt = (SELECT max(rpt_dt) FROM d WHERE $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP))
)
SELECT
  asset AS contract,
  CASE market WHEN '1' THEN 'Spot' WHEN '2' THEN 'Futures' WHEN '3' THEN 'Options on spot' WHEN '4' THEN 'Options on futures' ELSE market END AS market,
  trade_type,
  strategy_leg,
  any_value(exchange_fee) FILTER (WHERE NOT day_trade)::DOUBLE AS exchange_fee,
  any_value(registration_fee) FILTER (WHERE NOT day_trade)::DOUBLE AS registration_fee,
  any_value(total_fee) FILTER (WHERE NOT day_trade)::DOUBLE AS total_fee,
  any_value(total_fee) FILTER (WHERE day_trade)::DOUBLE AS day_trade_total_fee,
  (1 - any_value(total_fee) FILTER (WHERE day_trade)
    / nullif(any_value(total_fee) FILTER (WHERE NOT day_trade), 0))::DOUBLE AS day_trade_discount,
  any_value(rollover_exchange_fee + rollover_registration_fee) FILTER (WHERE NOT day_trade)::DOUBLE AS rollover_total_fee,
  any_value(prev_total_fee) FILTER (WHERE NOT day_trade)::DOUBLE AS prev_total_fee,
  (any_value(total_fee) FILTER (WHERE NOT day_trade)
    / nullif(any_value(prev_total_fee) FILTER (WHERE NOT day_trade), 0) - 1)::DOUBLE AS change,
  any_value(valid_from) AS valid_from,
  any_value(valid_to) AS valid_to
FROM l
GROUP BY asset, market, trade_type, strategy_leg
ORDER BY contract, market, trade_type, strategy_leg

panels.title: Fee changes vs previous publication
panels.description: Fee lines of the selected contracts whose total unit cost changed vs the previous publication.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    exchange_fee + registration_fee AS total_fee,
    lag(exchange_fee + registration_fee) OVER (
      PARTITION BY market, asset, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg
      ORDER BY valid_from
    ) AS prev_total_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND market IN ($market)
)
SELECT
  valid_from,
  asset AS contract,
  CASE market WHEN '1' THEN 'Spot' WHEN '2' THEN 'Futures' WHEN '3' THEN 'Options on spot' WHEN '4' THEN 'Options on futures' ELSE market END AS market,
  CASE WHEN day_trade THEN 'Day trade' ELSE 'Regular' END AS mode,
  trade_type,
  strategy_leg,
  prev_total_fee::DOUBLE AS prev_total_fee,
  total_fee::DOUBLE AS total_fee,
  (total_fee / nullif(prev_total_fee, 0) - 1)::DOUBLE AS change
FROM d
WHERE prev_total_fee IS NOT NULL
  AND total_fee <> prev_total_fee
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY valid_from DESC, abs(total_fee - prev_total_fee) DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Most expensive contracts (latest publication in range)
panels.description: Top 15 contracts by total unit cost of the base fee line in the selected markets and trade mode; ignores the contract filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade = $mode
    AND trade_type = '0'
    AND coalesce(strategy_leg, '0') = '0'
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  asset || ' (mkt ' || market || ')' AS contract,
  exchange_fee::DOUBLE AS "Exchange fee",
  registration_fee::DOUBLE AS "Registration fee"
FROM d
WHERE rpt_dt = (SELECT max(rpt_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY exchange_fee + registration_fee DESC, contract
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Biggest increases (range)
panels.description: Top 15 changes in total unit cost from first to last publication in range, in the selected markets and trade mode; ignores the contract filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    asset AS contract,
    CASE market WHEN '1' THEN 'Spot' WHEN '2' THEN 'Futures' WHEN '3' THEN 'Options on spot' WHEN '4' THEN 'Options on futures' ELSE market END AS market,
    arg_min(exchange_fee + registration_fee, valid_from)::DOUBLE AS first_total_fee,
    arg_max(exchange_fee + registration_fee, valid_from)::DOUBLE AS last_total_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade = $mode
    AND trade_type = '0'
    AND coalesce(strategy_leg, '0') = '0'
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT *, last_total_fee / first_total_fee - 1 AS period_change
FROM r
WHERE first_total_fee > 0
ORDER BY period_change DESC, contract
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Biggest decreases (range)
panels.description: Bottom 15 changes in total unit cost from first to last publication in range, in the selected markets and trade mode; ignores the contract filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    asset AS contract,
    CASE market WHEN '1' THEN 'Spot' WHEN '2' THEN 'Futures' WHEN '3' THEN 'Options on spot' WHEN '4' THEN 'Options on futures' ELSE market END AS market,
    arg_min(exchange_fee + registration_fee, valid_from)::DOUBLE AS first_total_fee,
    arg_max(exchange_fee + registration_fee, valid_from)::DOUBLE AS last_total_fee
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE market IN ($market)
    AND day_trade = $mode
    AND trade_type = '0'
    AND coalesce(strategy_leg, '0') = '0'
    AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT *, last_total_fee / first_total_fee - 1 AS period_change
FROM r
WHERE first_total_fee > 0
ORDER BY period_change ASC, contract
LIMIT 15

panels.title: $asset fee lines
panels.description: Total unit cost of every fee line (market, trade mode, trade type, strategy leg), one panel per selected contract.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  valid_from::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  concat_ws(' · ', 'mkt ' || market, CASE WHEN day_trade THEN 'day trade' ELSE 'regular' END, CASE WHEN trade_type <> '0' THEN 'tx ' || trade_type END, CASE WHEN strategy_leg IS NOT NULL THEN 'leg ' || strategy_leg END) AS line,
  (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_unit_cost/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset = $asset
  AND market IN ($market)
  AND $__timeFilter(valid_from::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, line
